title: Lineage
description: Data model for data lineage in a statistical production process.

dataset.title: DatasetReference
dataset.description: A GCS file with a generation, or a partitioned dataset root with inline member identities.

path.description: Canonical GCS object path or partitioned Parquet root, not a mounted alias.

generation.description: GCS generation for a single file; null or omitted for partitioned roots. Unknown for a single file means incomplete provenance.

members.description: Complete inline partition member identities with relative paths. No separate manifest file.

member.title: DatasetMember
member.description: An object belonging to a partitioned dataset, relative to its root.

path.description: Nonempty relative object path without traversal, URI scheme, or a leading slash.

generation.description: Exact GCS generation of this member, as a decimal string.

data_source.description: Input GCS datasets and the generations consumed by the transformation.

data_target.description: Successfully saved output GCS datasets and their finalized generations.

step.description: A string describing at which step in the process the log is for.

event_id.description: Stable identifier of this persisted lineage event.

segment_id.description: Identifier shared with quality and change events for this transformation.

recorded_at.description: Timezone-aware instant when this event was recorded, distinct from execution time.

git_commit_hash.description: Git commit of the code used for this transformation.

git_repository.description: Repository name or sanitized URI containing the executed code and its configuration.

git_dirty.description: Whether staged, unstaged, or untracked non-ignored changes existed. Null means unknown.

image_name.description: Complete container image reference from IMAGE_NAME, including its tag.

dapla_environment.description: Platform environment from DAPLA_ENVIRONMENT, not dataset publication status.

dapla_region.description: Platform context from DAPLA_REGION; DAPLA_LAB is not a geographic region.

execution_started_at.description: Timezone-aware execution start instant, preferably expressed in UTC.

execution_finished_at.description: Timezone-aware execution finish instant, preferably expressed in UTC.

timezone.description: Effective process timezone, preferably an IANA name. Null means unknown.

utc_offset_seconds.description: Effective UTC offset in seconds at execution start; does not replace timezone rules.

configured_tz.description: Configured TZ environment variable, not proof of the effective process timezone.

gsbpm_code.description: Optional GSBPM code from Klass classification 933; membership is checked by the logger.

producer_metadata.description: Team-defined JSON-compatible production details; cannot override named fields.
